Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		users: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.SuspensionDays>0)
	precondition:
		users.isEmpty() = false
	postcondition:
		users->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1) and
		users->forAll(u: User|u.SuspensionDays = 0 and
		u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND or
		u.SuspensionDays<>0 and
		u.BorrowStatus = u.BorrowStatus@pre)
}
